1.1 Some tips

These papers here might provide help and guidance for your task.

  • Baillie et al. (2022) - how to start looking at the data

  • Popovic et al. (2024) - overarching principles for reliable statistical ecology

  • Zuur et al. (2009) - how to explore data before proper analysis

  • Zuur & Ieno (2016) - how to report results from a regression analysis

  • Broman & Woo (2017) - how to organize data for further analysis

These papers also provide a way for me to show you hot to have automatic references in this report. For that to happen, all the work you cite must be included in the file ENrefs.bib, in the bibtext format. This file as well as a formatting file mee.cls must be in the same folder as the quarto .qmd file. If you do not have a reference manager that handles .bib format, this is the time to get one. JABREF https://www.jabref.org/is a free reliable option.
